name: hallucinote
description: Compose, arrange, sound-design, and mix songs with Claude. DB-backed MIDI authoring with live Ableton Live sync via MCP and intent-aware audio analysis.

plugins.name: hallucinote
plugins.description: Composition + production skills (/hallucinote:song-new, compose-part, mix-review, ableton-push, …), the hallucinote-mcp server (13 Ableton Live tools), and the composing engine — self-contained, nothing else to clone. Needs Ableton Live 12 and uv; run /hallucinote:ableton-mcp-install once to connect Live.
